taxonomy.correction: while is structured local iteration, not a non-local-exit primitive

decision.reason: while closes the documented unbounded-iteration gap using the existing compiler branch ABI, whereas catch/throw requires a new dynamically scoped Lisp unwind stack that the C2J top-level abort landing does not provide

while_contract.test: evaluated before every iteration; NIL terminates and every other object continues
while_contract.body: evaluated left-to-right on each admitted iteration; intermediate values are discarded
while_contract.lowering: both device and host compilers use the existing JFALSEREL and JMPREL opcodes; no VM opcode, resident dispatcher, root, journal field or runtime state is added
while_contract.failure: missing test, improper syntax or an out-of-range relative branch fails compilation closed

c2_lite_evidence.transaction_rule: no authenticated runtime-overlay transaction remains active while Lisp bytecode executes
c2_lite_evidence.abort_shape: all error and RUN/STOP exits pass through c2_product_abort_cleanup and then longjmp to the sole REPL top-level landing
c2_lite_evidence.journal_shape: C2J restores transaction state and wipes transient suffix records; it does not retain resumable Lisp control frames
c2_lite_evidence.transient_shape: active transient records are bounded execution identities, not catch frames or continuations
c2_lite_evidence.compiler_shape: dotimes and dolist already prove constant-stack loop lowering through JFALSEREL and JMPREL in both compilers

required_new_truths: a dynamically scoped stack of catch tag, VM frame, logical PC and value-stack depth
GC rooting for evaluated catch tags and thrown values across nested VM calls
precise unwinding to an inner bytecode continuation rather than the REPL top level
a distinction between catchable throw and fatal error or RUN/STOP abort
parity across device compiler, host compiler, evaluator bridge and nested vm_run_dir calls
catch_throw_cost.why_c2j_is_not_reusable: the C2J landing deliberately rolls back the current transaction, unpublishes active transient wrappers and longjmps to the REPL; using it for catch would destroy the dynamic context that catch must resume
catch_throw_cost.capacity_class: unmeasured resident VM and root-state change; incompatible with treating F5 as a paper-only stretch probe

future_boundary.catch_throw: deferred to a separately commissioned condition-and-unwind project
future_boundary.error: the existing fatal error path remains top-level and is not advertised as user-catchable

required_future_while_proof: multiple iterations preserve left-to-right side effects
test and body may allocate and trigger GC
a long-running loop has constant VM and C stack depth
malformed syntax and relative-branch overflow fail closed
device compiler, host compiler, host VM and device VM agree
language reference, migration surface and both special-form inventories include while
prohibitions: do not describe while as non-local exit
do not model C2J or transient records as Lisp catch frames
do not add catch/throw, block/return-from, tagbody/go or restarts in the while cut
do not add a new VM opcode when the existing relative-branch ABI suffices
do not implement F5 before a separately authorized product cut
